SELECT inf.algo_type_code AS algoTypeCode, inf.algo_type_name AS algoTypeName, inf.algorithm_code, inf.algorithm_name, oa.industry_code, oa.app_ver_code as appVersion FROM vm_order_algorithms oa JOIN vm_algorithm_info_t inf ON oa.algorithm_code = inf.algorithm_code JOIN vm_function_type fun ON inf.algo_min_type_code = fun.function_code WHERE oa.delete_flag = 0 AND oa.ord_status IN ( 0, 1, 2 ) AND inf.delete_flag = 0 AND fun.delete_flag = 0 and inf.algo_type_code is not null and inf.algorithm_code is not null and oa.order_code = #{orderCode} ORDER BY inf.algo_sub_type_code, inf.algorithm_code
